cancellationPolicy.title: Cancellation & Rescheduling Policy
cancellationPolicy.intro: We know life happens — but as a mobile grooming service, each appointment is reserved exclusively for you, including the travel time and preparation that comes with it. The policies below help us continue offering the personalized, unrushed experience every dog deserves.

sections.heading: 1. Rescheduling & Cancellations
sections.body: We kindly ask for at least 48 hours' notice for any cancellation or rescheduling request. This allows us to offer the time slot to another client on our waitlist.

rows: No fee — reschedule or cancel freely

sections.heading: 2. No-Shows
sections.body: If we arrive at your scheduled appointment and are unable to reach you or access your dog within 15 minutes of the scheduled time, this will be considered a no-show and charged at 100% of the scheduled service price.

sections.heading: 3. Late Arrivals
sections.body: We do our best to accommodate slight delays, but appointments are scheduled back-to-back to ensure every dog receives unrushed, individual attention. If you anticipate being more than 15 minutes late, please let us know as early as possible — we will do our best to adjust, though a shortened service or rescheduling may be necessary.

sections.heading: 4. Illness or Emergencies
sections.body: We understand that health emergencies — yours or your dog's — can arise without warning. Please reach out as soon as possible; these situations are handled with flexibility and are not subject to standard cancellation fees.

sections.heading: 5. Payment Method on File
sections.body: A valid payment method is required before you can reserve an appointment. After you choose your appointment date and time, you will add or select which saved card to use for that visit. You are not charged when you book. Payment is settled after your appointment. Late cancellations and no-shows may be charged to the selected card according to the policy above.

cancellationPolicy.outro: Thank you for understanding — these policies allow us to protect the time and care every dog on our schedule deserves, including yours.

fees.name: Flea & Tick Treatment Fee
fees.description: Every appointment begins with a thorough health and skin check. If parasites (fleas or ticks) are discovered on your pet, we will notify you immediately and perform a mandatory specialized medicated bath to protect your pet and prevent contamination. This additional fee covers the medicated shampoo treatment and complete sanitation of the mobile vehicle.
fees.descriptionZh: 每次预约开始前进行健康与皮肤检查。如发现跳蚤或蜱虫，将立即通知并强制进行药浴处理及车辆消毒。

lineItems.name: Medicated Flea & Tick Shampoo
lineItems.note: Mandatory surcharge applied automatically upon discovery of fleas or ticks during pre-groom inspection

lineItems.name: Vehicle Sanitation & Deep Clean
lineItems.note: Required for all parasite encounters to protect subsequent clients

fees.name: Behavior & Special Handling Fee
fees.description: Applied when a dog exhibits high stress, extreme anxiety, aggression, or resistance during grooming. Covers extra time, specialized safety handling techniques, extra patience, and safety measures required to maintain a secure environment for both your pet and the groomer.
fees.descriptionZh: 根据现场焦虑、抗拒或攻击程度评估，+$25–$50+。

seniorCare.name: Senior & Gentle Comfort Care
seniorCare.description: Specialized, low-stress care for senior dogs who cannot tolerate a standard grooming routine due to paralysis, post-surgical recovery, or serious illness. Prioritizes comfort, safety, and dignity over speed. Includes extra resting breaks, anti-slip support, adapted handling techniques, and gentle drying methods tailored to limited mobility and medical needs.
seniorCare.descriptionZh: 专为因瘫痪、术后恢复或严重疾病而无法承受常规美容流程的老年犬提供的低压力特别护理。优先保障舒适、安全与尊严，而非速度。包括额外休息、防滑支撑、适配式操作手法及温和吹干。

fees.name: Out-of-Service-Area Travel Fee
fees.description: Travel surcharge for clients located outside of our standard mobile grooming coverage area. Calculated at $6.50 per one-way mile based on GPS driving distance from our base location to your address via Google Maps. This single rate covers specialized grooming van fuel, vehicle wear and depreciation, and full round-trip travel time.
fees.descriptionZh: 超出标准服务范围后，按 Google Maps 从基地到客户地址的单程 GPS 里程，每英里 $6.50（10 英里免费圈内不加收）。

services.name: Long Coat Show Care
services.description:
A specialized weekly wash-and-care ritual for full-coat breeds — designed to preserve length, prevent matting, and maintain a silky, show-ready finish week after week.

The longer a dog's coat grows, the harder it becomes for natural oils and nutrients to travel all the way from root to tip. Without that nourishment reaching the ends, hair becomes dry, brittle, and far more prone to tangling and matting. Long Coat Show Care is built around this exact challenge — a meticulous, multi-step process using coat-specific professional-grade shampoo and conditioner formulated to restore moisture and strength along the full length of the coat, keeping it soft, tangle-resistant, and beautifully maintained.
services.bestFor: Full-coat breeds maintained on a weekly grooming schedule, where preserving length and preventing matting is a priority — including Shih Tzu, Yorkshire Terrier, Maltese, Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, or any dog being kept at full coat length.
includes: Pre-Bath Detangling: Careful line-brushing to prevent matting before washing
Multi-Step Coat Wash: Layered application of specialized shampoo and deep conditioner suited to full-coat texture
Hand Blow-Dry & Straightening: Directional drying to preserve length and maximize shine
Full Line-Brush Finish: Section-by-section brush-out for a smooth, tangle-free result
Nail Care: Clipping and smooth electric filing with dremel
Ear Care: Specialized ear cleaning with protective cotton ball placement
Sanitary trim and paw-pad hair shaved

services.bestFor: Heavy double coats and high-shedding breeds
services.description: Mineral-rich Dead Sea mud wrap and whole-body massage. Deeply nourishes skin, exfoliates, releases muscle tension, and restores coat shine.

services.name: Aromatherapy Essential Oil Bath Soak
services.description: Warm-water soak infused with 100% pet-safe organic essential oils (lavender & chamomile) paired with targeted joint-relief massage. Calms anxiety and leaves the coat silky, glossy, and fresh-scented.

services.name: Sensitive Skin & Dander Soothing Treatment
services.nameZh: 皮屑与敏感肌舒缓护理
services.description: Therapeutic bathing session tailored for sensitive skin, flaky dander, or seasonal allergies using hypoallergenic botanical wash and soothing oatmeal/aloe skin treatments. Relieves dryness and reduces coat static.

services.name: Custom Full Haircut & Styling
services.nameZh: 高端定制全套造型精剪
services.description: Full-service personalized grooming experience. Includes everything in the Signature Bath & Care, followed by a customized whole-body groom styled to your preferences (e.g., teddy bear head, custom length, or breed standard).

services.name: Hand Stripping Specialty
services.description: Specialized coat preservation for wire-haired breeds (such as Terriers and Schnauzers). Preserves rich coat color, harsh texture, and natural skin protection by manually removing blown coat. Charged at an hourly rate due to the intense precision and time required.
services.note: If a bath is desired immediately after hand stripping, please add a Signature Bath & Care service to your booking.

serviceCategories.name: Add-On Care

services.name: DeMatting & Gentle Brush-Out
services.description: Safe and patient mat removal for light to moderate tangles using specialized dematting sprays and tools. We prioritize your dog's comfort and skin safety at all times.
services.descriptionZh: 使用专用开结喷雾与工具，安全、耐心地处理轻度至中度打结，始终优先保障狗狗的舒适与皮肤安全。
services.policyNote: To protect your pet's skin and ensure a stress-free experience, dematting is limited to a maximum of 15–30 minutes. If matting is severe or close to the skin, we will kindly recommend a smooth, safe shave-down for your pet's comfort and health.
services.policyNoteZh: 为保护皮肤并确保低压力体验，开结时间上限为 15–30 分钟。若打结严重或贴近皮肤，我们将建议进行平滑、安全的剃短处理。

services.name: DeShedding Treatment
services.description: A deep-penetrating, coat-restorative treatment designed to release trapped undercoat and drastically reduce shedding. Includes a specialized deshedding shampoo & conditioner soak, high-velocity blow-out, and thorough undercoat carding/brushing.
services.descriptionZh: 深层渗透、修复毛发的护理，帮助释放底层死毛并显著减少掉毛。包含专用祛毛洗护浸泡、高速吹干及彻底的底层毛发梳理。

options.name: Temporary Fun
options.description: A small-area accent using a one-time, pet-safe coloring product. Color typically washes out after 1–2 baths.

options.name: Ears & Tail Accent
options.description: A subtle, playful pop of color to showcase your dog's personality. Ideal for smaller areas like ears or tail.

options.name: Paws & Boots Accent
options.description: A cohesive and stylish look designed to make your dog shine! Covers four paws, ears, and tail with rich, vibrant single-color application.

options.name: Custom Creative Design
options.description: The ultimate luxury color experience. Fully customized artistic designs, multi-color gradient blending, or specialized patterns tailored specifically to your vision and your dog's coat.

items.title: Consultation & Pre-Approval Required
items.body: All creative color services begin with an advance consultation. Please share your color preferences and any reference photos beforehand, so we can custom-prepare a specialized, non-toxic formulation tailored to your vision.

items.title: Pet Safety & Temperament Come First
items.body: Your dog's comfort and well-being always come first. We use exclusively 100% pet-safe, non-toxic, washable or semi-permanent dye formulations, and every service is guided by your dog's individual comfort and skin condition. Please let us know in advance if this will be your dog's first coloring experience, or if they have any known allergies or skin sensitivities.

items.title: Coat Condition & Pricing Adjustments
items.body: To ensure the safest, most beautiful results, final pricing may be adjusted based on your dog's natural coat color, density, texture, and coat condition.

items.title: Duration & Fade Expectations
items.body: Pricing reflects a single coloring application. Depending on the depth and intensity of the chosen color, the dye will typically fade completely within 1–3 baths.

items.title: Permanent Coloring Requests
items.body: For permanent dye applications that will not wash out and can only be removed through coat trimming, please contact us in advance to discuss and schedule this service separately.
